Desperate people confront curses, corrupt powers, and choices whose victories always carry a price.
A sunless border holds its harvest behind oath-bound gates. Recover a stolen dawn bell, expose the cost of protection and choose who may claim the last safe fields.
Three witch houses divide a valley by inherited curses. Investigate a broken naming pact, rescue its unnamed children and decide whether the houses retain their bargains.
A procession seeks a cure carried by a living saint. Separate disease from imposed penance, protect the sick and choose the conditions under which the cure is shared.
Protect excluded residents without signing away their harvest
Expose broken promises and imposed penance
Renew bargains under accountable shared witnesses
Record chosen identities, fair defense and voluntary care

A three to four hour Dying Marches game: A sunless border holds its harvest behind oath-bound gates. Recover a stolen dawn bell, expose the cost of protection and choose who may claim the last safe fields.
Open with a silent bell and tenant grain being seized.
Distinguish a real defense need from the captain’s private levy.
Offer contract witnesses, patrol repair and a decoy route at visible costs.
Record who controls the bell, pays defense and keeps harvest.

A three to four hour Witch Principalities game: Three witch houses divide a valley by inherited curses. Investigate a broken naming pact, rescue its unnamed children and decide whether the houses retain their bargains.
Use gestures and mirrors to communicate with erased children.
Never assume adult representatives may choose the children’s identities.
Offer the heir’s testimony, shared witnesses and an unowned registry.
Record each child’s chosen name and the houses’ remaining obligations.

A three to four hour Plague Pilgrimage game: A procession seeks a cure carried by a living saint. Separate disease from imposed penance, protect the sick and choose the conditions under which the cure is shared.
Open at the penance gate with a patient who needs food and care.
Distinguish symptoms, irritant smoke and imposed moral judgments.
Offer water testing, measured doses and a voluntary care rotation.
Record treatment priority, cure knowledge and the bearer’s right to leave.
